summary: This directory manages the definition, composition, and evaluation logic for approval policies. It provides mechanisms to combine multiple decision-making criteria into cohesive approval workflows and handles the resolution of conflicting or aggregate policy results.
responsibilities: Aggregate and merge multiple approval decisions
relationships: Composite approval policies delegate evaluation to individual policy components.
Decision merging logic interprets the outcomes of multiple policies to produce a final authorization result.
designDecisions: Separation of individual policy evaluation from aggregate decision resolution
